use_case_name: Monitor Current and Past Auction Status

claims.content: Internal users (Auctioneers, Customer Service Reps, Help Desk staff) want to monitor current and past auction statuses. This includes viewing the auction history of specific product items (SKU History) and the bid/order history of specific customers (Customer History), including details such as dates/times, bid counts, winning bidders, and order statuses.

scope_contract.goal_statement: Internal users (Auctioneers, Customer Service Reps, Help Desk staff) want to monitor current and past auction statuses. This includes viewing the auction history of specific product items (SKU History) and the bid/order history of specific customers (Customer History), including details such as dates/times, bid counts, winning bidders, and order statuses.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: Customer accesses the auction/Bid History view for a specific product item and sees each auction's status (Unscheduled, Scheduled, Current/Live, Closed), with current/live auctions shown as Active and past auctions showing closing date/time, bid counts, and winning bid/winning bidder information.
scope_contract.start_boundary: Customer initiates the auction status view for a specific product item.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The current and past auction status details are displayed to the customer.
in_scope_actions: Open the auction/Bid History view for the selected product item
View past auction status and closing dates/times
View auction status categories and bid-related details (bid counts, last bid, SmartBid, winning bid/winning bidder)
variant_dimensions: Auction status category types shown (Unscheduled, Scheduled, Current/Live, Closed)
Current/live vs past/closed presentation (Active vs closing date/time)

claims.content: Customer
The user is logged in as Auctioneer within the Auction Admin workspace.
The user initiates the view of auction performance history for a specific SKU by entering the Product ID and clicking "Go."
The user selects the SKU History Page from the Auction Admin Main Menu.
The customer enters the Product ID (SKU) for the specific product item and clicks “Go.”
The system displays the search results in two sections: a top section with product summary data and a bottom section listing auction history data on separate lines.
The bottom section lists each auction record with Auction Status, Auction Sequence, Start Date/Time, End Date/Time, Reserve Amount, High Bid, Number of Bids, and Winner / High Bidder.

Diverges from Step 1: Instead of selecting the SKU History Page from the Auction Admin Main Menu, the user selects the Customer History Page from the Auction Admin Main Menu to monitor a specific customer's auction status history.

Diverges from Step 2: Instead of entering a Product ID and clicking 'Go', the customer clicks the 'Recently Ended Auctions' link on the page, and the system displays the last 24 hours of auction history.
Diverges from Step 3: In the displayed search results, the user rearranges the default order of item attribute columns.

Diverges from Step 4: From the search results display, the user clicks the 'Export to Excel' button under the search results, and the system generates a CSV file of all data in the search results for manual tracking.

Diverges from Step 4: For won items, when the customer's default payment type is PayPal or Amazon Payments and they have not yet paid, the Payment Status column shows 'Not Paid' in bold red text and includes a link to the 'Returning Winner's Payments' page.

Diverges from Step 4: In the Bid History section, a current/live auction is shown as 'Active' in place of a closing date/time, while past auctions show the closing date/time, auction sequence numbers, product ID (SKU), the customer's last bid, SmartBid if placed, and the winning bid.

If the customer's search for the Product ID (SKU) in Step 2 returns no matches, the system displays a 'No Results' page that includes a 'Search Tips' section advising the user to check for typos/misspellings, remove unnecessary words like 'and', 'the', or 'a', try plural and singular forms, use fewer or more generic keywords, and contact support if the tips fail.

missing_aspects: EF-address-validation: The 'Confirm City, State, Zip with the customer' validation exception (EC-EF-008) cannot be anchored because main_flow Step 2 is a Product ID search; main_flow should be extended with a Customer History/customer-search step.

EF-deactivated-account: The deactivated-account red-text display (EC-EF-006) applies to customer search results and cannot be anchored to the current SKU-history main_flow; a customer-search step is needed.

EF-not-paid: The unpaid PayPal/Amazon Payments 'Not Paid' status and Returning Winner's Payments hyperlink (EC-EF-001, EC-EF-002) require an order-status/customer-history step in main_flow to anchor; the exit/handoff to payment is not specified.
EF-cancelled-order: The cancelled-order red-text display (EC-EF-007) requires an Order History section step in main_flow to anchor; no recovery/exit beyond the visual flag is documented.
EF-no-results-recovery: After the No Results page, no explicit retry/return-to-Step-2 behavior is documented; only Search Tips and support contact are specified.
Explicit confirmation of whether the exception flow terminates or allows further interaction after displaying the No Results page.

claims.content: For the specified SKU, the system displays the SKU auction performance history in two sections: a top section with product summary data (Product ID, description, type, cost, price, thumbnail image, auction history metrics, buyer name, inventory quantities, and active date) and a bottom section listing individual auction records on separate lines with Auction Status, Auction Sequence, Start Date/Time, End Date/Time, Reserve Amount (Opening Bid), High Bid, Number of Bids, and Winner / High Bidder.

The system displays the current and past auction status details to the customer, including the Product Description/Specifications section (with SKU, Type, Brand, Width, Metal Type, etc.) and the Item Bid History section (listing Name, Amount, Date Placed, and SmartBid User? for each bid).

The system displays the customer's current and past auction status history, including a Bid History section that lists each auction record with closing date/time (or 'Active' for live auctions), auction sequence numbers, product ID (SKU) numbers, the customer's last bid, SmartBid if placed, and the winning bid. Cancelled orders appear in RED.

On the customer's My Bid History page, the system displays items the customer previously bid on (won and not won), sorted by ending time with the most recent on top, with linked Item #s to Product Details; for won items, a Payment Status column shows 'Paid' or 'Not Paid', and if unpaid via PayPal/Amazon, 'Not Paid' appears in bold red and links to the Returning Winner's Payments page.

missing_aspects: PO-auction-status-category-enumeration: No valid postcondition evidence card explicitly enumerates the four auction status categories (Unscheduled, Scheduled, Current/Live, Closed) from the scope contract.

citation_audit.description: Latest model-authored candidates after internal semantic grounding verification and DRA; aligned with delivered slots.
